issues.description: Page is stuck in 'Analyzing your room...' loading state. The pre_detection_result data is not being loaded or the component never transitions out of the loading state. No furniture items, no room image with overlays, no keep/remove toggles, and no Continue button are shown.
issues.element: Main content area - entire step-7c page content
issues.root_cause: The page component at apps/web/app/design/step-7c/page.tsx is likely reading pre_detection_result from a store or session that is empty/null at render time. The loading state condition never resolves because either: (1) the data key being read from localStorage/sessionStorage doesn't match what was written by the previous step, (2) there's a hydration mismatch causing the client to re-render in a broken state (5+ hydration errors in PAGE ERRORS confirm this), or (3) useEffect that loads the data is not firing or not finding the data. The hydration errors from other pages (step-3) also indicate a broader SSR/client mismatch issue with localStorage access.

issues.description: Multiple hydration errors (7 instances) across the app. Text content mismatches between server and client rendering, caused by accessing localStorage or other browser-only APIs during SSR.
issues.root_cause: Components are reading from localStorage/sessionStorage or using browser APIs during server-side rendering, causing HTML mismatch. The step-7c page likely reads store data without a mounted guard (useEffect + isMounted pattern missing).

fixes.new_str:
const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isMounted, setIsMounted] = useState(false);
fixes.reason: Add isMounted state to prevent SSR/hydration mismatches from localStorage reads
Guard all data-loading effects behind isMounted to prevent SSR hydration mismatches and ensure localStorage is only accessed client-side
